APPROVED_WORK_PACKAGE.REQUIRED_END_STATE: Exactly ten real managed resources with stable external-key identity, Ansible-only mutation, native refresh, transactional Terraform state, scoped ownership/delete, safe runner behavior and canonical convergence.

Preserve exact interfaces/provider source/inventory/Terraform-Core state authority; use stable external-key IDs, Ansible for mutation, native Read, failure-safe state transitions and scoped deletion; honor content/text/account/cron contracts; use structured argv and cleanup; normalize equivalent state; preserve build/runtime compatibility and prohibit wrapper/provisioner/manual-state substitutes.

SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENTS.provider-contract.md: Terraform Core owns durable state; one resource owns one external key; mutation may invoke Ansible; Read is native-only; process failures/timeouts/cancellation fail; temp playbooks clean; state publish follows successful mutation.
